numbered_text:
[1] This was our second time staying here and was great. [NAME] turned on the AC before we arrived which was nice since there was a heat wave. The place is close to restaurants and bars and a short 12 to 15 minute walk from the train station and also close to the subway and a short 8 to 10 minute walk to Dam Square. A grocery store is a short block away. Overall a great place!
[2] Essentially uni accommodations with poor facilities and very far from central
[3] We've stayed here a few times - always appreciate the friendly staff, the location (for our specific purposes, though others might find it wanting), and the fridge+tea kettle. In case it's helpful for folks with particular needs, the pillows are a little puffy (unfortunately they don't have flatter ones). Will be back!
[4] Great facilities, especially for working remotely and the building also had a gym. Coffee shops and a great park nearby. Further out from the city but right next to the tram. You can hear the neighbours a bit so if you have loud neighbours it isn't great but overall really good for what we wanted. However, they decided to test the fire alarms every morning at 5:30am, 7am and 9am which was awful.
[5] It has a great location. The apartment is very clean. Check-in was very easy. We especially loved the terrace. We didn't experience any problems. We were very satisfied.
[6] This place was great! It had a wonderful, homely vibe and tons of room. Everything we needed for a perfect trip. Amazing house in middle of Amsterdam. Thanks for hosting us...
[7] The flat was corresponding to the description. we didn't have any of the problems some other people have mentionned. only little thing to say is that it can quickly smell humidity if you don't let the bathroom light on for a while so that the air vent really get that humidity out. The fact there are bicycles availables are a big plus. i would recommand this stay
[8] Great location, perfect for a couple staying in the city centre for a few nights. The place was easy to get to, clean and comfortable.
[9] The most Airbnb didn't match the advertised description at all. It was completely different to the advertised photos, different apartment, different view! If I've known that was it I wouldn't have booked. No spare towels or napkins, no aircon the place was really hot we had to open the windows to be able to sleep, but it was quite noisy when window was left open and we couldn't the desire privacy.
[10] Staff is kind and helpful but the hotel and location are not great. The street where the hotel is located is particularly dirty and noisy.
[11] It's a low key hotel. Not fancy and a little tough on the edges (years of service that shows in the bathrooms, the floors, ceilings etc. ) but for the price it's an absolute super place to be. Tune your expectations down and you will be happy. Tune then up, and you might get disappointed.
[12] This house is an excellent base to explore Amsterdam. We loved the little ferry across from the station, and it was much quieter than the center.
[13] This apartment is a fantastic space to enjoy Amsterdam. It is very central, with Central Station approx 15 minute walk. The bedrooms are large as is the living area. Small amount of noise can be heard outside at night, however this is a welcome trade off for being so central
[14] We loved our stay! Perfect location for the main sites and great local restaurants. Would definitely love to stay again. Thank you so much ☺️
[15] We needed to catch the first Eurostar to London so this was the perfect place for a night. The room is small, so we had to do some tetris to walk around with our luggage but nothing that wasn't manageable. Good shower. There were hairs in the bed and some stains in the walls.
[16] Im so glad I booked this because of the fantastic location. [NAME] is so nice and even helped me find things to do to make the most of my time.
[17] [NAME] is very friendly and welcoming. He took the time to explain all the details and specifique. Very well located, walking distance to pretty much eveything! Loved our stay!
[18] Good location, close to town. Although a bit noisy. But worth it for location
[19] A very central location for a few days in Amsterdam. Easy to walk everywhere but the downside is it can be noisy so pack earplugs. The space was completely fine for me and my friend. Everything was clean and check in and out went smoothly. As well as ear plugs, bring an eye mask as the blinds are very thin. A great few days in the city!
[20] The location of the hotel and the communication of the employees were good. A place I can choose again. When our coffee machine was broken, they immediately made up for it. Access to the center is very easy. I definitely recommend it. ✨✨
[21] Nice room near to the airport (20 min ride in train) and to the central station (15 min ride in train). There is a lot of public transportation near the apartment, so, it's real easy to go to the city center. The host was really nice and waited for me for a late check in (like, really late!). I recommend this accommodation to everyone who comes to Amsterdam ☺️
[22] [NAME] is a very kind, warm and helpful hostess. The apartment is clean and beautiful and the bed is extremely comfortable. The room has everything you need if you're traveling with just a small backpack.
[23] Great location. Can be a little loud due to crowds in the evening and seagulls in the morning. Breakfast is a fantastic inclusion.
[24] Great location, we walked everywhere in Amsterdam. Very friendly front desk. The room was spacious enough. We were 4 people in one room. Beds were very comfortable. Room was decently cleaned. There wasn't any AC unfortunately, despite the fact that outside the temperature was well below 70, in the room was very hot and humid. The host provided 2 fans but they were not enough. Overall pleasant stay. Would recommend for a short stay.
[25] I had a great stay here in Amsterdam. The location was perfect — everything was very walkable and it was conveniently close to the train station, which made getting around super easy. The room and bed were very comfortable, and I appreciated being allowed an early check-in after traveling. The decor was cute and thoughtfully done, and the space felt very private with minimal noise. Overall, a really relaxing and enjoyable stay. Thanks for the amazing experience!
[26] Perfect for 2 people, kinda small but we stay there for sleep. Hoster was very kind all the time and the area was very nice aswell, 2km from museums, great for us. Unfortunally the refrigerator didnt work properly but that wasnt a problem. We recommend it !
[27] [NAME] place was excellent, an amazing location right in the middle of everything and a very cute spot with anything you could need. It does get noisy at night being in the middle of town but she provides ear plugs for you which helps. I'd definitely stay here again it was wonderful 🤍
[28] This air bnb was in such a good location, it was close to everything. You can easily access the trains if you want to get further out, or if you simply want to walk everywhere everything was within a 20 min radius. The place was the perfect size and being right on the canal was the icing on top. [NAME]-[NAME] was always quick to respond with anything, would definitely recommend staying here.
[29] We were surprised the place is in the red light district. We have two young kids, so we have to always walk around to avoid the windows of women standing to attract men. The place didn't have an elevator, but [NAME] and his staff were extremely helpful to bring luggages up and down for us. [NAME] is a great host and I give him high rating. However, compare to other places we have stayed at, this place is quite outdated. Unfortunately in Amsterdam there are very few AirBnB to choose from.
[30] [NAME]'s “yellow” room is lovely and bright. Perfect for my friend and I on a 4 day trip to Amsterdam. The location is right at the red light district, so very fun and touristy, and we had the best time wandering through all the canals. Everything is walking distance. Our only complaint is that the hand rail was broken on the very steep stairs making a bit of a hazard. Other than that we loved our stay. Thanks [NAME].
[31] I really enjoyed my stay! The lady who welcomed me was lovely, very kind and patient. I had no issues with noise and overall everything was very smooth and comfortable. Just a small suggestion for improvement: I believe the bathroom light could be replaced, as it doesn't provide much brightness. Other than that, everything was perfect!
[32] [NAME]'s place was perfect for our family of three, centrally located to make it easy to get to most major sights within 10-20 minutes but on a quiet street so there wasn't road noise while we were sleeping. Newly renovated, immaculately clean and cozy. Would definitely stay there again.
[33] We really enjoyed our stay here. The beds were super comfortable, and the room was very spacious. There is lots of closet room to unpack for longer stays. They included a mini fridge, kettle, and coffee maker which was a plus. The bathrooms are super tiny, and when showering it gets the whole bathroom wet and is slightly uncomfortable, which was the only downside of the rooms. It is about an hour walk into dam square, but it's a beautiful walk in the city, and close to the airport.
[34] Wonderful accommodation, pleasant host, great value for the price. But there are a couple of downsides I can't help but notice: the room was incredibly hot, impossible to sleep without a fan, and the street outside is very noisy, so you'll likely have trouble sleeping without earplugs.
[35] Unfortunately no canal view as shown on the pictures, but everything else was very good !
[36] Aside from the noisy people in the room next to ours, who kept banging doors middle of the night, the rest of our stay was great! It's a place I like to come back to and have stayed in more than 1 property of theirs. Always a breeze!
[37] This was a great stay! It was fun to stay in an old church and they have done the place up so nicely. The restaurant was nice, staff were great, bed was comfortable. The biggest downfall is that you can hear everything the other guests are doing if you stay in the pods- arriving in the middle of the night and making lots of noise, digging through their bags, stomping around, etc.
[38] This was not my first time here and it won't be the last! I love the location, amenities, privacy and comfort of this room. I highly recommend it!
[39] The instructions for finding this place is very poorly written. It delayed us from checking-in by at least 30m-1h. They use an AI chatbot which wasn't very helpful and led us to the wrong floor. Getting a live person to reach back out to us took at least 30m. **The room is located on the FIRST floor, which is not indicated on the elevator directory either.** Other than trying to find the room, everything else was great. Very spacious and had everything that we needed.
[40] Great place, but there's a lot of noise from outside, try to bring earplugs for sleeping.
